reliability.space_filling_advice: The model has not yet shown it can rank unseen runs (CV Spearman below the 0.2 floor, its 95% interval reaching 0, or too few runs to judge), so this batch explores rather than exploits. verdict.rule: Refused: no held-out score, fewer than 3 groups of runs, or the upper end of the score's 95% interval at or below 0. Reliable: score at or above the floor, the lower end of its 95% interval above 0, at least 20 runs and 8 groups of runs. Not yet: everything else.
